title: Initialize Playwright Support for Insights View with Functional Tests
description: Verify that Playwright test support is correctly integrated with the Insights view for Functional tests
testDescription: Configure and verify that Playwright can properly access and interact with the Insights view for Functional tests similar to Unit, Integration, and API tests
prerequisites:
1. Playwright testing framework is installed and configured
2. Insights view is already implemented for Unit, Integration, and API tests
3. User has appropriate permissions to access the Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Initialize Playwright test environment with required configurations
2. Import necessary Insights view modules and utilities
3. Create a basic test that navigates to the application
4. Navigate to the Insights view section
5. Select the Functional tests tab/section in the Insights view
6. Verify that the Insights interface loads correctly
expectedResult:
1. Playwright test setup completes without errors
2. Insights view loads successfully with Functional test section
3. The interface shows the expected structure for Functional test insights
4. Console shows no errors related to Playwright-Insights integration

title: Verify Functional Test Results Display in Insights View
description: Confirm that executed functional test results are correctly displayed in the Insights view
testDescription: Run functional tests and verify that their results appear correctly in the Insights view with appropriate status indicators, timing information, and execution details
prerequisites:
1. Playwright support for Insights view has been implemented
2. At least 5 functional test cases with varying results (passed, failed, skipped) exist
3. User has permissions to view test results
stepsToPerform:
1. Execute a set of functional tests via Playwright with known outcomes
2. Navigate to the application and log in
3. Access the Insights view
4. Filter or select to view only Functional test results
5. Verify that all executed test cases appear in the list
6. Check that test status (pass/fail/skip) is accurately represented
7. Verify that test execution times are displayed
8. Confirm that test details can be accessed by clicking on individual tests
expectedResult:
1. All executed functional tests are displayed in the Insights view
2. Test statuses match the actual execution results
3. Pass/fail/skip indicators use appropriate visual elements (colors, icons)
4. Test execution times are accurate
5. Test details can be expanded or accessed for additional information

title: Validate Filtering and Sorting of Functional Test Results in Insights View
description: Verify that filtering and sorting capabilities work correctly for functional test results in the Insights view
testDescription: Test the ability to filter and sort functional test results based on various criteria such as test status, execution time, test name, and date of execution
prerequisites:
1. Playwright support for Insights view has been implemented
2. Multiple functional tests with varying statuses and execution times exist in the system
3. User has permissions to access the Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the application and access the Insights view
2. Select or filter to view Functional test results
3. Test filtering by status (passed, failed, skipped)
4. Test filtering by date range
5. Test filtering by test name/description (using search)
6. Test sorting by execution time (ascending and descending)
7. Test sorting by test name (alphabetical)
8. Test sorting by status
9. Apply multiple filters simultaneously
10. Clear all filters and verify default view returns
expectedResult:
1. All filters produce the correct subset of test results
2. Sorting correctly arranges test results according to the selected criterion
3. Multiple filters work in combination to further refine results
4. Clearing filters restores the default view with all results
5. Filter and sort controls are responsive and intuitive
6. Filter status indicators show which filters are currently applied

title: Verify Cross-Browser Compatibility of Insights View for Functional Tests
description: Ensure the Insights view displays and functions correctly across different browsers when showing functional test results
testDescription: Test that the Insights view for Functional tests works consistently across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge browsers with proper rendering and functionality
prerequisites:
1. Playwright support for Insights view has been implemented
2. Functional test results are available in the system
3. Playwright is configured with multi-browser support
4. User has permissions to access the Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Configure Playwright to run tests in Chrome browser
2. Navigate to Insights view and verify functionality for Functional tests
3. Repeat the same test in Firefox browser
4. Repeat the same test in Safari browser (if applicable)
5. Repeat the same test in Edge browser
6. For each browser, verify:
   - Correct rendering of all UI elements
   - Proper functioning of filters and sorts
   - Accurate display of test results
   - Responsiveness of the interface
   - Ability to interact with test details
expectedResult:
1. Insights view renders correctly in all tested browsers
2. All functionality (filtering, sorting, viewing details) works consistently across browsers
3. Visual elements maintain proper alignment and sizing in different browsers
4. No browser-specific console errors or warnings appear
5. Performance is acceptable across all browsers

title: Test Data Export and Reporting from Functional Test Insights
description: Validate that functional test results can be exported and reports can be generated from the Insights view
testDescription: Verify the capability to export functional test results in various formats and generate reports with customizable parameters from the Insights view
prerequisites:
1. Playwright support for Insights view has been implemented
2. Functional test results with various statuses exist in the system
3. User has permissions to access and export data from Insights view
4. Export and reporting features are enabled
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the application and access the Insights view
2. Filter to view Functional test results
3. Locate and click on export/download options
4. Test exporting data in CSV format
5. Test exporting data in JSON format
6. Test exporting data in PDF format (if supported)
7. Test generating a summary report
8. Test generating a detailed report with test case specifics
9. Test applying filters before export to limit exported data
10. Verify the exported data matches what is displayed in the UI
expectedResult:
1. Export options are available and functional
2. Each export format (CSV, JSON, PDF) correctly contains all relevant test data
3. Generated reports include appropriate headers, summaries, and details
4. Filtered exports contain only the filtered subset of data
5. Exported data accurately reflects the test results shown in the UI
6. Export process completes without errors
7. Downloaded files can be opened and contain valid data

title: Validate Error Handling for Failed Functional Tests in Insights View
description: Verify that failed functional tests display appropriate error details and debugging information in the Insights view
testDescription: Test how the Insights view handles and displays failed functional tests, including error messages, screenshots, and logs to aid debugging
prerequisites:
1. Playwright support for Insights view has been implemented
2. Several functional tests with deliberate failures exist
3. User has permissions to access the Insights view
4. Error capturing mechanisms are enabled for functional tests
stepsToPerform:
1. Execute a set of functional tests containing intentional failures
2. Navigate to the application and access the Insights view
3. Filter to show only failed functional tests
4. Select a failed test from the list
5. Verify error message visibility and clarity
6. Check for screenshot availability for the failure point
7. Examine console logs and error traces
8. Verify that stack traces are properly formatted and readable
9. Test any 'replay' or 'debug' options if available
10. Check that error categorization (if implemented) is accurate
expectedResult:
1. Failed tests are clearly marked with visible indicators
2. Error messages are descriptive and help identify the cause of failure
3. Screenshots of the failure state are available and can be viewed
4. Console logs and error traces provide sufficient debugging information
5. Stack traces are properly formatted and navigable
6. Any debugging tools or options function correctly

title: Test Responsiveness of Insights View Across Different Screen Sizes
description: Verify that the Insights view for functional tests adapts appropriately to different screen sizes and device types
testDescription: Validate that the Insights view maintains usability and proper layout across desktop, tablet, and mobile screen sizes when displaying functional test results
prerequisites:
1. Playwright support for Insights view has been implemented
2. Functional test results exist in the system
3. Playwright is configured to emulate different viewport sizes
4. User has permissions to access the Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Access the Insights view at desktop resolution (1920x1080)
2. Verify all functional test data and controls are visible and usable
3. Resize to tablet dimensions (768x1024) using Playwright viewport settings
4. Verify layout adjusts appropriately and all content remains accessible
5. Resize to mobile dimensions (375x667)
6. Test navigation, filtering, and viewing test details on mobile layout
7. Verify that all critical information remains visible and accessible
8. Test interaction with UI elements (buttons, filters, details expanders) at each size
9. Check for any overflow issues, text truncation, or inaccessible controls
expectedResult:
1. Insights view correctly adapts layout to each screen size
2. All functional test information remains accessible across device sizes
3. UI controls remain usable at all viewport dimensions
4. No horizontal scrolling is required (except for data tables if applicable)
5. Text remains readable and is not cut off
6. Filter and search functionality works at all sizes
7. Test details can be accessed regardless of screen size

title: Verify Integration Between Functional Test Execution and Real-Time Insights Updates
description: Test that newly executed functional tests promptly appear in the Insights view with accurate data
testDescription: Validate that when new functional tests are executed, the results are correctly processed and displayed in the Insights view without requiring manual refresh
prerequisites:
1. Playwright support for Insights view has been implemented
2. User has permissions to execute tests and access Insights view
3. Real-time or periodic update mechanism is implemented
stepsToPerform:
1. Open the application and navigate to the Insights view
2. Note the current functional test results and timestamps
3. In a separate process, execute a new batch of functional tests
4. Wait for the configured update interval (or trigger manual refresh if required)
5. Verify that new test results appear in the Insights view
6. Check accuracy of test status, execution time, and other metadata
7. Run another test with a predictable outcome (pass/fail)
8. Verify this specific test result appears correctly
9. Check timestamps to confirm recency of data
10. If real-time updates are implemented, verify update occurs without manual refresh
expectedResult:
1. Newly executed functional tests appear in the Insights view
2. Test statuses, execution times, and other data are accurate
3. Updates occur within expected timeframe (real-time or according to refresh interval)
4. Specific test results can be traced from execution to appearance in Insights
5. Timestamps reflect actual execution times
6. No duplicate entries or missing test results

title: Test Authentication and Authorization for Insights View Access
description: Verify that proper authentication and authorization controls are in place for accessing functional test data in the Insights view
testDescription: Validate that access to functional test insights is restricted based on user roles and permissions, and that unauthorized users cannot view sensitive test data
prerequisites:
1. Playwright support for Insights view has been implemented
2. Multiple user accounts with different permission levels exist
3. Functional test results are available in the system
4. Authentication system is properly configured
stepsToPerform:
1. Attempt to access Insights view without logging in
2. Log in with a user account that has no permissions for Insights view
3. Verify access is denied with appropriate message
4. Log in with a user that has read-only permissions for Insights
5. Verify the user can view functional test results but not execute or modify tests
6. Log in with a user that has full permissions
7. Verify all features including execution, filtering, and exporting are available
8. Test direct URL access to Insights view components while logged out
9. Test accessing API endpoints that provide Insights data with different authentication tokens
expectedResult:
1. Unauthenticated users are redirected to login page
2. Users without permissions cannot access the Insights view
3. Read-only users can view data but not modify or execute tests
4. Fully-privileged users have access to all features
5. Direct URL and API access attempts are properly secured
6. Appropriate error messages are displayed for unauthorized access attempts
7. No sensitive test data is leaked to unauthorized users
tags: playwright, insights, functional-tests, authentication, authorization, security

title: Validate Performance of Insights View with Large Functional Test Datasets
description: Test how the Insights view performs when displaying and processing large volumes of functional test results
testDescription: Verify that the Insights view maintains acceptable performance and usability when loaded with hundreds or thousands of functional test results
prerequisites:
1. Playwright support for Insights view has been implemented
2. Large dataset of functional test results is available (500+ test cases)
3. User has permissions to access the Insights view
4. Performance monitoring tools are available
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights view in the application
2. Filter to show only functional test results
3. Measure initial load time for the page
4. Configure to display maximum number of results per page
5. Measure rendering time for the full page of results
6. Test scrolling performance through long lists of results
7. Apply filters to the large dataset and measure response time
8. Sort the dataset by different criteria and measure sorting time
9. Search for specific test cases in the large dataset
10. Export or generate reports from the large dataset
11. Monitor memory usage during these operations
expectedResult:
1. Initial page load completes within acceptable time (< 3 seconds)
2. Rendering of test results is performant (< 1 second for visible elements)
3. Scrolling is smooth without lag or freezing
4. Filter operations complete within reasonable time (< 2 seconds)
5. Sorting operations complete quickly (< 2 seconds)
6. Search returns results promptly (< 1 second)
7. Exports and reports generate without timing out
8. No out-of-memory errors or excessive memory consumption
9. UI remains responsive throughout all operations
10. Pagination works effectively for large result sets
tags: playwright, insights, functional-tests, performance, large-datasets, optimization

title: Test Search Functionality in Insights View for Functional Tests
description: Validate that the search functionality in the Insights view correctly filters functional test results based on search criteria
testDescription: Test the ability to search for specific functional test results using various search terms like test names, descriptions, and error messages
prerequisites:
1. Playwright support for Insights view has been implemented
2. Multiple functional test results with various test names, descriptions and statuses exist
3. User has permissions to access the Insights view
4. Search functionality is enabled for Functional test results
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the application and access the Insights view
2. Switch to the Functional tests tab/section
3. Locate the search input field
4. Enter a specific test name that exists in the results
5. Verify search results update in real-time or after submitting search
6. Clear the search and enter a keyword that appears in multiple test descriptions
7. Verify partial matching works correctly
8. Search for an error message that appears in failed tests
9. Test case-sensitivity of the search function
10. Test searching with special characters
11. Enter a search term that should return no results
expectedResult:
1. Search functionality is accessible and responsive
2. Searching by test name returns exact matches
3. Searching by keywords in descriptions returns all relevant tests
4. Searching by error messages finds relevant failed tests
5. Search respects case-sensitivity settings (if applicable)
6. Special characters are handled appropriately
7. 'No results' state is displayed correctly when search has no matches
8. Search results update within acceptable performance parameters
9. Search functionality maintains consistent behavior across browsers

title: Test Pagination in Insights View for Large Sets of Functional Test Results
description: Verify that pagination functionality works correctly when displaying large sets of functional test results
testDescription: Test that users can navigate through multiple pages of functional test results with appropriate controls and consistent display of data
prerequisites:
1. Playwright support for Insights view has been implemented
2. A large number of functional test results exist (enough to span multiple pages)
3. User has permissions to access the Insights view
4. Pagination is implemented for the Insights view
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights view and select the Functional tests section
2. Observe the default page size and pagination controls
3. Navigate to the second page using the 'Next' button
4. Navigate to a specific page number directly
5. Navigate to the last page using the 'Last' button if available
6. Navigate back to the first page using the 'First' or 'Previous' buttons
7. Change the page size setting if available (e.g., from 10 to 25 results)
8. Verify pagination updates with the new page size
9. Apply a filter that reduces results to less than one page
10. Verify pagination controls adjust accordingly
11. Apply a search that spans multiple pages
expectedResult:
1. Pagination controls are visible and functional
2. Navigating between pages shows correct sets of test results
3. Current page is clearly indicated
4. Page size can be adjusted and functions correctly
5. Total number of results/pages is displayed accurately
6. When filtering reduces results to fit on fewer pages, pagination adjusts correctly
7. Search results maintain pagination state
8. No duplicate results appear across pages
9. No missing results between pages
10. Page transitions are smooth and maintain scroll position appropriately

title: Verify Historical Trend Analysis for Functional Tests in Insights View
description: Test that the Insights view correctly displays historical trends and performance metrics for functional tests over time
testDescription: Validate that users can view and analyze historical performance trends of functional tests, including pass rates, duration changes, and frequency of execution
prerequisites:
1. Playwright support for Insights view has been implemented
2. Historical data for functional tests from multiple test runs exists in the system
3. User has permissions to access the Insights view
4. Trend analysis features are enabled for functional test results
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights view and select the Functional tests section
2. Locate and select the historical trends or analytics view
3. Verify presence of trend charts for pass/fail rates over time
4. Check that test execution duration trends are displayed
5. Verify date range selectors function correctly
6. Select a different time period (last week, last month, custom range)
7. Verify data updates according to selected time period
8. Test interaction with trend charts (hover tooltips, click for details)
9. Check if trends can be filtered by specific test suites or categories
10. Verify that trend data can be exported if the feature exists
11. Compare trend data with actual test history for accuracy
expectedResult:
1. Historical trend data for functional tests is visible and accurate
2. Charts and graphs correctly represent pass/fail rates over time
3. Test execution duration trends are accurately displayed
4. Date range selectors properly filter the displayed data
5. Trend data updates correctly when time periods are changed
6. Interactive elements of trend charts function as expected
7. Filtering trend data by test categories works correctly
8. Export of trend data (if available) functions properly
9. Data visualizations are clear and provide valuable insights
10. Trend analysis helps identify patterns in test reliability and performance

title: Test Integration Between Functional Tests and Other Test Types in Unified Insights View
description: Verify that functional test results are properly integrated with Unit, Integration, and API test results in a unified Insights view
testDescription: Validate that users can view and analyze functional test results alongside other test types with proper categorization and cross-referencing capabilities
prerequisites:
1. Playwright support for Insights view has been implemented for all test types
2. Results exist for Functional, Unit, Integration, and API tests
3. User has permissions to access all test types in the Insights view
4. Unified view or cross-referencing features are implemented
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights view's unified or dashboard view
2. Verify that all test types (Functional, Unit, Integration, API) are represented
3. Check that summary metrics show aggregated data across all test types
4. Filter to view only certain test types and verify filter functionality
5. Locate a feature that has tests across multiple test types
6. Verify cross-referencing functionality between related tests
7. Check that status indicators and metrics are consistent across test types
8. Compare performance metrics between different test types
9. Verify that unified search works across all test types
10. Test any correlation features that link related tests across types
expectedResult:
1. All test types are visible in the unified Insights view
2. Functional tests are properly categorized and distinguished from other types
3. Summary metrics accurately aggregate data across test types
4. Filtering by test type works correctly
5. Related tests across different types can be identified and linked
6. Consistent status indicators and formatting are used across test types
7. Performance metrics are comparable between test types
8. Unified search returns relevant results from all test types
9. Correlation features correctly identify related tests
10. The unified view provides valuable insights across the testing pyramid

title: Validate Custom Tagging and Categorization of Functional Tests in Insights View
description: Test the ability to apply and filter by custom tags and categories for functional test results in the Insights view
testDescription: Verify that users can create, apply, and filter by custom tags and categories to organize and analyze functional test results more effectively
prerequisites:
1. Playwright support for Insights view has been implemented
2. Functional test results exist in the system
3. User has permissions to access and modify the Insights view
4. Custom tagging/categorization features are enabled
stepsToPerform:
1. Navigate to the Insights view and select the Functional tests section
2. Locate the custom tagging or categorization controls
3. Create a new custom tag (e.g., 'Critical-Path', 'Performance-Sensitive')
4. Apply the custom tag to selected functional test results
5. Verify that tagged tests show the appropriate indicators
6. Filter the view to show only tests with a specific custom tag
7. Create and apply a different tag to another set of tests
8. Test multi-tag filtering (tests with both Tag A AND Tag B)
9. Test exclusion filtering (tests with Tag A BUT NOT Tag B)
10. Verify that custom tags persist across sessions
11. Test removing tags from selected tests
expectedResult:
1. Custom tagging functionality is available and operational
2. New tags can be created successfully
3. Tags can be applied to selected test results
4. Tagged tests display appropriate visual indicators
5. Filtering by custom tags returns the correct subset of tests
6. Complex filtering with multiple tags works correctly
7. Custom tags persist when user logs out and logs back in
8. Tags can be successfully removed from tests
9. The system prevents invalid tag operations
10. Tagging helps organize and prioritize test results effectively
